title: Let Me Die
description: A fast-paced Minecraft minigame where the SpeedRunner must fulfill deadly objectives while Hunters race to stop them.
body:
# 🎮 Let Me Die – Speedrunner Death Challenge

**Let Me Die** is a competitive Minecraft challenge plugin where one Speedrunner must die in specific randomized ways while Hunters try to stop them before time runs out.

Inspired by Manhunt-style gameplay, this plugin transforms survival into a high-intensity death objective minigame.

(Note 1:**If You are using this plugin in youtube please just credit me in video description                      by   giving link for this plugin in your video description**)

(Note 2:**Please do not reupload or modify this plugin**)

---

## ⚔ How It Works

Each round assigns a unique death challenge like:

> "Player tried to swim in lava...", each game have 5 round and each round will have different goals, hunter won't know your death!

- The Speedrunner has limited time to complete the exact death objective.
- If they succeed → speedrunner score.
- If time runs out → Hunters score.
- Wrong death? The round continues.

After multiple rounds, a live scoreboard and cinematic final result screen determine the ultimate winner.

---

## 🔥 Key Features

- ⚔ Speedrunner vs Hunters competitive system  
- 🎯 Randomized death objectives per round  
- ⏳ BossBar countdown timer  
- 📊 Live scoreboard during gameplay  
- 🧭 Hunter tracking compass  
- 🔄 Multi-round configurable system  
- ⚙ Fully configurable via `config.yml`  
- 🧠 Perfect for YouTube challenge videos and   

---

## 🎥 Perfect For

- Minecraft challenge videos  
- Manhunt-style content  
- SMP events  
- Competitive PvP minigames  

---

## 🧩 Compatibility

- ✔ Paper  
- ✔ Spigot  
- ✔ Purpur  
- 🧪 Tested on Paper 1.21.1  

---

## 🛠 Commands

- `/start <player>` — Start the challenge  
- `/hunter add <player>` — Add a hunter  
- `/lmd continue` — Start next round  
- `/lmd setspawn` — Set arena spawn  
- `/lmd stop` — Stop the game  
- Having queries join discord and ask there
